title: Dockerfile installs unpinned packages
reason: Accepted risk: the base image is pinned by immutable digest, which fixes the apt package snapshot for the build. Pinning apt versions in Debian-slim is fragile (point releases purge old versions and break reproducible builds); project policy updates the base-image digest via Dependabot. Not a code/secret vuln.
